risk_description: Too large  tolerances of the installed axle unit in combination with the installed tyre and rim tolerances can cause the tyre to collide with the mudguard support plate when the axle compresses, damaging the inside of the tyre. This can lead to a sudden loss of tyre pressure while driving, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
